## Question and thesis

How can a library preserve particular objects, enable access, respect personal space and make reading wanted without allowing any one of those purposes to authorize every method? The received material supports an institution enacted through differentiated practices: Ui preserves and interprets old words, negotiates access and guards proximity; Shimiko matches readers, lends books, makes comfortable spaces and defends circulation. Their shared affiliation connects these practices but does not make their collections, authority, preferences or effects identical. The library is intelligible through the decisions its workers and users actually make, including ordinary pleasure and disagreement, rather than through an unreceived universal charter. [U:36–38/64–70/108; S:36–42/74–86; P:373–445/509]

Reading, making, sorting, sharing chocolate, coffee, company and sleep are substantial outcomes in this account. An actually found book and an actually comfortable rest need no crisis result to become meaningful. A wished-for rare volume remains unfound even when the search gives real companionship; successful craft remains pleasurable even when it costs Ui rest. The argument therefore preserves achieved enjoyment, declined or incomplete service, and recipient costs together. Ordinary evidence neither waits for institutional usefulness nor supplies an exemption from responsibility. [P:268/381–445/534–560; L56:37–45/67–71; V:109/141/149; W:165–169]

They do not prove that all spaces a librarian enters are the chair's property, that an expert owns every visitor's response, or that the reported magician epithet names supernatural power. Shimiko's reported objection to treating the library as private property is institutionally consequential precisely because it distinguishes the office, cared-for objects and a person's space. It remains reported disagreement, rather than a newly heard direct joint scene. [U:54/64–70/108/116; S:64/74–82/130; P:455/509]

Later library approval changes local procedure; the exchange proposal remains represented and prospective. They do not authenticate a complete charter, unrestricted legal power, a treaty document or all future circulation. Appointment, practical decision and the reach of authority must remain separate claims. [W:106–112/150–159/173; S:84–86]

## Eight serious competing readings

1. A benign sanctuary reading has found books, wanted reading, comfortable work, cushions, actual rest and local approval in its favor. It fails as a total account when it makes force, coercive education, pressure, sleeplessness and unknown stock permission incidental. A wanted space is a substantive good whose methods remain answerable. [P:417–445; V:149; W:148–169]

2. A coercive gatekeeper reading sees real punishment, exclusion, threatened force and concealed knowledge. It fails when it discards useful referral, recipient checks, chosen invitations, actual lending, comfort and achieved access. Contrary conduct must constrain the thesis without erasing positive acts or making all service fraudulent. [P:375–445; U:126–132; S:154–164]

3. A flawless expert system reading can cite Ui's specialty and Shimiko's profiled collection knowledge and successful search. It cannot turn a profile into audited omniscience, a failed treasure into a found book, a referral into performed restoration, or an inner estimate into validated throughput. Competence remains positively located in different tasks and finite endings. [P:435–461; U:64–70; S:64/68/156; V:149]

The distinct sites, Shimiko's reported private-property objection and Ui's visitor-referral complaint, Shimiko's reader matching, EVENT851 rest cost and EVENT852 adjustment disagreement resist it. The relation is significant through different authors and recipients, not through compulsory sameness. [U:64/108; S:74–86/130; P:489/509; V:149; W:152]

5. A service-and-productivity reading treats leisure as reward or fuel for work. The failed treasure's enjoyed company, personally wanted reading, bookmark/costume making, specific coffee, birthday alternative and actually good rest resist that reduction. Their value is intrinsic while they keep achieved, wanted and incomplete states. Neither political usefulness nor a high-stakes consequence is required. [P:268/381–461; U:40/74–82; S:90–100; W:169]

6. A harmless fiction reading has comedy, wanted research and audience pleasure as evidence. It overreaches when the show hides armed pursuit, stock permission and Ui's lost rest, or a false princess persona is validated by genuine criticism.
